name: Komori Satoshi
source:
He aims to make his debut at school with his somewhat unpromising appearance and personality, but he has never successfully confessed his feelings and has never had a girlfriend. He is a virgin.

When asked to do a favor, he reluctantly accepts the request, feeling that it is a pain in the ass to refuse. He has always been toyed by the younger sisters, and is good at taking care of them.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/MEH-008/]official site[/url]]
